notes: Stack: Foundry, solc 0.8.27, EVM Prague (EIP-1153 transient storage available), optimizer 777 runs. ERC-7579 modular account on ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7; UUPS upgradeable; ERC-7739 signature validation; EIP-7702 delegation incl. PREP flow.

contracts/Nexus.sol:305-333 initializeAccount: if msg.sender != address(this), classic path requires Initializable.requireInitializable() (transient flag set by NexusProxy constructor); 7702 path (NEW in delta) takes a 65-byte signature prefix + initData, checks !isInitialized(), checks erc7702InitHashes[keccak256(initData)] unused, requires ECDSA.recover(initDataHash, sig) == address(this), then marks hash used. NOTE: the signed hash is the RAW keccak256(initData) with no chain id, no domain, no account-address binding beyond the recovered signer == address(this) check.

contracts/Nexus.sol:335-357 _initializeAccount: parses (bootstrap, bootstrapCall) from initData head via assembly, delegatecalls bootstrap, requires success; post-init isInitialized() check is SKIPPED for 7702 accounts (line 353). The bootstrap address comes from caller-supplied initData with no allowlist in this function.

contracts/lib/Initializable.sol:19-34 requireInitializable() is now non-view and CONSUMES the flag (tstore(slot, 0x00)) — PR #302 fix for GHSA-q47q-h6x2-f5qg. Single-use within the deploying transaction. NexusProxy constructor calls setInitializable() then upgradeToAndCall.

contracts/lib/local/LibPREP.sol:19-45 (NEW, local copy of lib-prep): rPREP hashes (digest, salt>>160) and masks to 160 bits; isValid recomputes the EIP-7702 delegation-designation hash (0x05 + RLP(0, delegation, 0)) and tryRecovers with v=27, s=hash(r); isPREP reads live delegation via LibEIP7702.delegation(target).

contracts/Nexus.sol:519-548 _handlePREP: assembly-unpacks (saltAndDelegation, initData, cleanedSignature) from PREP-mode userOp signature, requires data.length >= 0xf9, calls LibPREP.rPREP(address(this), keccak256(initData), saltAndDelegation), reverts InvalidPREP on r==0, emits PREPInitialized(r). It does NOT itself initialize the account; the caller (validateUserOp PREP branch, line 125) consumes initData/cleanedSignature.
contracts/Nexus.sol:555-575 _checkInitializedValidators: skipped entirely for 7702 accounts (first condition !_amIERC7702()).
contracts/base/ModuleManager.sol:624 _amIERC7702(): detection helper (read by Hunters for exact mechanism — address.codehash / delegation check).

contracts/interfaces/base/IStorage.sol:53 AccountStorage.erc7702InitHashes mapping(bytes32=>bool): replay store for relay-init hashes. Stored in account storage; for 7702 accounts the storage lives at the EOA address.

contracts/utils/NexusBootstrap.sol (delta): version 1.2.1; init entry points take a validators[] array with doc 'should not contain the default validator'; loop skips address(0) entries (continue). Whether a default-validator entry in validators[] is REJECTED or silently double-installed is a Hunter check.

Trust boundaries: (1) initializeAccount classic path trusts the deploying transaction only (transient flag); (2) 7702 relay path trusts an ECDSA signature from the account address itself over raw initData hash — relayer is untrusted, signature is the only auth; (3) PREP path trusts the delegation-designation proof (r) tying target+delegation; (4) bootstrap delegatecall trusts caller-supplied bootstrap address during init only; (5) EntryPoint/self-only guards on execution paths are OUT of delta scope except where init paths interact.

Unresolved boundaries for Hunters: exact _amIERC7702 detection semantics and spoofability; Solady ECDSA.recover malleability/invalid-signature behavior at the pinned solady version; whether isInitialized() (external call to default validator) can revert or be griefed during relay init; PREP r-value reuse across chains/accounts (saltAndDelegation has no chain id); LibPREP local copy vs upstream lib-prep diff (behavioral drift?).
